question: How can I add descriptions to enum values in OpenAPI using Fern?
ground_truth: OpenAPI doesn't natively support adding descriptions to enum values. To add descriptions in Fern, you can use the `x-fern-enum` extension. This extension allows you to specify descriptions for each enum value, and these descriptions will propagate into the generated SDK and docs website. The `x-fern-enum` extension also supports a `name` field that allows you to customize the name of the enum in generated code, which is particularly useful for enums with symbolic characters.
